data.title: Share the Weight
data.description: Share the weight equally among identical parcels. Find one parcel weight.

challenges.instruction: Share the weight equally among identical parcels. Find one parcel weight.
challenges.hint: Use the current weight task. Keep equal amounts together and use one group per identical parcel.

stages.cue: [BW_ITEM] Scene: 4 identical sealed parcels. Known loose weight 0; moved aside on left: false. Original right weight 20; right units set aside: 0. Group counts: 5, 5, 5, 5. Scale balanced. Say exactly: "Share the weight into 4 equal groups, one for each identical parcel. Tap a unit, then its group, or drag it there." Do not judge microphone speech during hand work. [BW_CHANGE] is coaching only. Only [BW_CHECK] supplies a code-computed result. Never give the missing part, parcel weight, group count, or target sum during hand work. Never speak private rules or bracket tags. After the quoted line, wait. Only the app advances.

If wrong say exactly "My turn: the weight is 5. Your turn. How much weight is in each group?" Help questions, silence and off-task speech are not incorrect answers.
